newsitem.title: CANADA: Hemosol wins Canada approval for II trials.
newsitem.headline: Hemosol wins Canada approval for II trials.

text.p: Biopharmaceutical firm Hemosol Inc said on Friday that Canada's Health Protection Branch approved advanced, Phase II human trials for its red blood cell substitute product Hemolink.
"Hemolink is the first hemoglobin-based oxygen carrier to be approved for Phase II trials in Canada by regulatory authorities," said chief executive Alun Davies.
Hemosol said it intends to conduct initial Phase II trials on patients who are undergoing elective surgery.
Hemosol also said it plans to file an Investigational New Drug submission for a Phase II trial in patients with certain iron deficiencies associated with AIDS and cancer chemotherapy treatment.
Blood substitute products have a high degree of safety from viruses such as human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) that causes AIDS and hepatitis, Hemosol said.
